headline: A Brass F.P. Journe Sold For More Than Gold
stop_reason: Not built (attempt 3). The 'more than gold' comparison is unverified: no dated gold price and no source comparing the brass-movement lot with gold was found. The only verified sale is Antiquorum Hong Kong, 31 May 2025, lot 152 (Octa Calendrier, platinum case, brass movement, HKD 1,500,000 against an estimate of HKD 650,000 to 1,000,000). That sale is about six months old, outside the 'last few weeks' window for auction results, and no permitted photo of that exact lot was found. Other brass-movement results found (Phillips, CHF 635,000 and CHF 533,400) are from a different house and have no matching comparison. Suggest a new angle: a current F.P. Journe market trend from dated sources, or a buyer's choice question on a current, photographed model.
